environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL enabled (auth_type=NONE), consuming from SQS queue 'order-events'. The SQS queue has no message validation or content filtering. The Function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abc123.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/ allowing anyone to POST replay requests. The downstream GraphQL API (AppSync) accepts any well-formed query from requests bearing the SERVICE_API_KEY.

config.graphql_backend: AWS AppSync with API key auth
